args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump the pin
to 2.9.4, which is the fixed version in the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades the `fastjson` pin in `requirements.txt` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4`.

## Why
- fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. `2.9.4` is the fixed version on the 2.x line.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
